transitionRules: PAGE_ENUMERATION_COMPLETE requires all expected pages and per-page status/echo/count reconciliation; it says nothing about later corrections or unobserved provider changes.
OBSERVED_STABLE requires comparable complete passes over the exact same canonical scope and equal receipt/metadata digests; it is not an immutable provider snapshot.

RECONCILED_AS_OF additionally requires approved lookback/freshness policy, current correction watermark, resolved issuer/instrument master and crosswalk scope, and exact current rights for required actions.

Any failed/omitted page, count mismatch, changed scope, unresolved identity, stale correction watermark, unapproved required rights action, or missing denominator prevents a complete/reconciled state.
Coverage is source-scope specific; one source's completion never fills another source's gap or proves the full universe complete.

queryScopeNormalizationContract.defaultResolutionRule: Apply a provider default only when the official endpoint guide documents it and the profile pins that guide revision; distinguish absent, explicit, and default-resolved values in canonical input.

UNPROFILED_RSS_OR_PROVIDER.rule: Do not hash a raw URL containing credentials or infer provider parameter semantics. Require an owner-reviewed allowlisted parameter profile and rights scope first.

decisionGatePlan.statusSemantics: Register scope/owner/acceptance requirements do not imply APPROVED. Current status is derived from the verified latest decision-evidence ledger revision; an empty ledger leaves all decisions OPEN.
reopenOn: source terms or product revision changes
schema drift or unreviewed external writer found
master/crosswalk revision or subject applicability changes
manifest digest or lineage verification fails
decisionGatePlan.gateRule: A decision approval is necessary only for its exact registered scope; it is not sufficient by itself to activate persistence, reconciliation, or public consumers. Each consumer also requires its own implementation and acceptance gates.

currentRepositoryEvidence.claim: Checked-in ordered migration history is the repository migration source; latest tracked migration is V165.
currentRepositoryEvidence.limitations: Does not prove any database environment has applied the full sequence or matches checksums.

currentRepositoryEvidence.claim: A read-only local audit compares Flyway success history with repository migration files and inspects selected destructive migration preconditions.
currentRepositoryEvidence.limitations: The script permits localhost only, does not inspect production, does not repair history, and does not establish external writers or grants.

currentRepositoryEvidence.claim: Health output exposes flywayVersion, schemaReady, and missingTables for an accessed application/database pair.
currentRepositoryEvidence.limitations: A health response is not a complete catalog, ownership, privilege, trigger, view, dynamic SQL, or backup inventory.

currentRepositoryEvidence.claim: Local migration-history drift and destructive preconditions are documented as unresolved; automated migration/history repair is prohibited.
currentRepositoryEvidence.limitations: Planning document does not replace a fresh environment snapshot or restoration rehearsal.

relationDenominator.scopeRule: include every non-system schema and every relation kind; explicitly classify extensions and temporary objects
relationDenominator.omissionDetection: compare accessible namespaces and relation-kind totals with independent information_schema/pg_catalog summaries; record privilege-denied scopes and expected-but-absent relations

columnAndConstraintDenominator.querySource: pg_attribute, pg_constraint, pg_index and information_schema cross-check
columnAndConstraintDenominator.omissionDetection: per relation compare attribute/constraint/index counts and definition digests across catalog query revisions; inaccessible relation marks inventory incomplete

programmableObjectDenominator.omissionDetection: include disabled/internal triggers as classified rows; compare object counts by kind and explicit permission visibility; unresolved definitions keep drift UNKNOWN

privilegeDenominator.querySource: pg_roles, pg_namespace/pg_class ACLs, information_schema role grants and default privileges
privilegeDenominator.omissionDetection: run as an approved catalog auditor, include PUBLIC and inherited memberships, record visibility limitations and compare effective privileges with ACL source rows

catalogQueryCoverage.rule: Zero rows establish absence only inside a declared schema/object scope when query success, privilege visibility, independent counts and expected-set denominator reconcile; otherwise the result is UNKNOWN.

writerDenominatorContract.rule: Static repository scan is a lower bound. It cannot establish a complete writer denominator without deployment inventory, effective grants and owner attestation.

environmentMatrix.knownSafetyBoundary: Repository access, health checks, and local audit cannot prove deployed schema or enumerate unregistered external writers.

run approved additive migration dry-run and row/hash reconciliation
obtain named DB owner approval for exact environment and artifact

empty writer inventory without owner attestation and source coverage
backup existence without successful restore rehearsal
